Hi Avery — thanks for the redlines and the PO sample. Quick answers up front, and then a proposed plan.

Field ownership (Redwood):
- tax_id: Legal Ops (markus_klein) — will validate EIN formatting
- remit_address: Finance (marissa_cole) — will provide canonical remit string
- PO prefix: Integrations (jonas_weber) — handles EDI/Ariba prefixes
- acknowledgement window: Platform SRE/Integrations (jonas_weber) — default 48h, can be adjusted by SLA

We accept both Ariba XML and EDI 850. For new partners we typically onboard via Ariba; if Seacliff prefers EDI we will provision an EDI gateway and map the 850 -> internal PO model (adds ~3 business days for mapping/testing).

Proposed immediate next steps: 
1) Legal redline sync (Markus): review liability cap and data residency language and confirm final positions by end of day Thursday.
2) Mapping workshop (Jonas + Marissa): 45-min call with your procurement tech lead to walk the OrderForm columns and agree on field transforms — target Friday.
3) Portal enrollment: once redlines are settled and we have mapping signoff, we submit Ariba vendor enrollment and estimate 5-7 business days to activate the vendor (can be shorter with expedited ops).

If that works I will schedule the legal quick call + a separate mapping session.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Avery — I reviewed Seacliff's redline (v3) and left comments on three discrete items:
1) Liability cap: propose keeping to a multiple-of-fees cap rather than unlimited carveouts. I suggested language that ties the cap to 12 months of fees under the Order Form.
2) Data residency: we can agree to process EU-origin data in EU regions with contractual commitments but cannot guarantee physical storage on customer-controlled infrastructure; suggested an addendum instead of changing core MSA.
3) PO acknowledgement SLA: we can accept 48-hour ack but need an explicit exception process for large EDI/CSV bulk batches.

Avery, I can do a 20-min legal alignment with you Thursday 10:00-10:20 PT to confirm. Vanessa, please loop me into the mapping workshop so I can confirm wording that aligns with the vendor onboarding artifacts (field names in Ariba vs. our OrderForm).

Markus Klein

Hi all — follow up from today's mapping workshop (notes below). Thanks, Avery, for joining and for providing the sample PO columns. Summary and action items: 

Mapping decisions made:
- Seacliff PO field "BuyerRef" -> Redwood "customer_po_number" (string, max 50)
- "ShipTo" -> "delivery_site_code" (validated against site list)
- "PODate" format: ISO yyyy-MM-dd required
- Line-level unit_of_measure: must be present; default to "EA" if not supplied
- Acknowledgement window: agreed 48 hours for single POs; bulk CSV batches require 5 business days for processing

Action items:
- Marissa: provide canonical remit_address string and preferred invoice email by EOD Monday (attachment: remit_template.csv)
- Jonas: create Ariba field mapping spreadsheet and pre-populate transform rules by Monday
- Markus: finalize redline responses and provide clause language for the liability cap and data-residency addendum by Monday EOD
- Avery: confirm whether Seacliff will register via Ariba network or request EDI gateway (reply to thread)

Notes: We tested a sample PO payload in the sandbox during the call; no schema errors after trimming an extra metadata column on Seacliff's export.

Next touchpoints: 
- Legal sync (20 min): Thu 10:00 PT (Markus + Avery + Vanessa)
- Ops mapping review (45 min): Fri 09:30 PT (Jonas + Marissa + Avery)
